dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... Paimon doesn't remember seeing this many manuscripts last time we were here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She must have published these ones later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, she wrote this many books, even after Durin was born? Let's see...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Weird... Is it just that Paimon hasn't read enough, or were none of these ever actually published...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wonder which story these are for...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, looks like a lot of work went into it, so it must be a pretty great one.

choices.text: Maybe it's one we haven't read yet.
